versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the repository.
- No user-facing features or functional changes.

- Added Typeform brand logo to documentation for improved visual clarity.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- No functional or setup changes. Documentation update only.
Fix display name: show app name only (was including tool list).

Initial release of Typeform integration via ClawLink.

- Manage forms, responses, themes, workspaces, and webhooks in Typeform directly from chat.
- Powered by ClawLink, enabling secure, credential-free setup (no API keys required from user).
- Includes step-by-step pairing and connection flow for seamless integration.
- Enforces confirmation before sensitive changes (e.g., edits, deletions).
- Comprehensive guidance for troubleshooting and resource links provided.
